commit.message:
refactor: simplify memory_correct with retry + GET-before-create

Replaces the complex delete+regenerate+recover fallback in memory_correct
with a cleaner flow:

1. PATCH with exponential backoff - retries on transient errors (429/500/503), up to 3 attempts
2. On 400/404: GET the memory to confirm it doesn't exist
3. If gone: CREATE with the new fact via consolidation pipeline (direct_memories_source)
4. If exists: surface the PATCH error (something else is wrong)

What changed:
- Removed old-fact backup and recovery dance
- Added exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s) for transient failures
- GET-before-create instead of blind delete+regenerate
- Uses direct_memories_source (consolidation pipeline) for creation
- Updated README to reflect new behavior

Mirrors: https://github.com/Shubhamsaboo/openclaw-vertex-memorybank/pull/15

fix: add topic labels to few-shot generated memories

Add managed_memory_topic labels to the positive few-shot examples
so the model learns the association between facts and topics.

Closes #2

fire-and-forget for captureFromConversation

Capture no longer awaits the full API response. The POST fires and
returns immediately (~140ms), letting Memory Bank process asynchronously.

syncFiles still awaits (needs success to update hash index).
memory_correct still awaits (agent needs result for response).
